name: Ram Screen
idea: A teammate screens the big's defender first, then the big runs up to set a pick and roll.
why: In a pick and roll, the screener's defender helps stop the dribbler. A ram screen makes that defender run into a screen first, so they're a step late. By the time they catch up, the dribbler is past the pick, and the screener is rolling to an open basket.
tryit: Ram screener: set a down screen on the big's defender, then get out of the way. Big: sprint up to set the pick, then roll hard to the hoop.

frames.say: {1} has the ball at the top. {5}, our big player, is down low, and {2} is by the free-throw line. {X2} is helping in the middle.
*Ram:* {2} runs down and sets a screen on {X5}, the big's defender.
{5} runs up around the screen and sets a pick on {X1}. {X5} got stuck, so {X5} is a step behind.
{1} dribbles around the pick. {X5} has to stop {1}, so {5} rolls to the basket with nobody behind.
Layup! Screen the screener's defender first, and the pick and roll is wide open.
